Review ChaoWei restaurant
Sep 2026 • Family
Delicious fresh beef hotpot, very worth trying. Fresh, tender beef, sliced to eat and with a natural sweetness. The hot pot broth is fragrant and rich, and it pairs very well with vegetables and dipping items. The portion is quite generous, the ingredients are prepared cleanly, and the presentation is beautiful. The restaurant space is comfortable and clean, suitable for dining with family or friends. The service staff were cheerful, enthusiastic, and brought the dishes quite quickly. Reasonable price compared to the quality of the food. I am very satisfied and will definitely come back next time!
